tube_painting.name: A line takes up room
tube_painting.description: Ada pipe, cable and tube workbench: continue suspended paths or twenty-one supplied forms, branch from a run, join at named ports, or attach to the wall.
tube_painting.status: Installed in the authored museum route; native integration verification recorded with the spine review.

parameters.study: Adapter selected by the installed scene; use its labelled pointer controls.

interactions: Grab a free end and extend; release at the amber marker to join another run, or at the wall to attach.
Hold the pen trigger to draw; start beside an existing run to branch. VIEW cycles path, rings and skin for drawn runs.
FORM chooses tube, hollow pipe or drafted cable for the last run and next stroke. SAG changes the last cable; NETWORK loads the combined example.
PARTS cycles sixteen pipe/glass forms in four groups. CABLES shows five cable arrangements. Grab any free part port to draw a new run; the supplied part stays fixed.
UNDO restores pieces, geometry and sockets together. Release held ends before editing. Eight pieces and runs share the workbench.
